first_candidate_basis: general reader-dependency, artifact-form, and completion guidance; no new model results inspected
selection_rule: best tuning candidate gets one validation evaluation; prefer over v4 only if mean pairwise preference > 0.5, no decrease in fidelity pass rate, no increase in material-error frequency; tie retains v4
second_candidate_basis: Qualitative analysis of 25 completed triples across seven tuning cases, before inspecting validation or holdout. Targets relational fidelity, source-grounded bridges, voice-sample boundaries, and correct proof connections.
